subject: Re: Quick qual — demo & calendar pick
messages:
From: Elliot Price <elliot@storewise.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-23T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Quick demo request - self signup

Hi Ben,

I signed up for Redwood yesterday (trial account: elliot@storewise.com) and wanted to get a short demo focused on integrating Redwood into our search stack. High level: we run a product search service for a mid-market retail platform (StoreWise) and are evaluating embeddings + reranking to reduce false positives.

Rough numbers: about 12M searches/month today, average query length ~12 tokens, peak concurrent queries ~1100/day, but only ~40 QPS sustained traffic. We're most interested in throughput/cost tradeoffs and whether Dedicated or Hosted is better for us.

Would love a quick 30-min walkthrough this week (we're flexible). Also attaching a small traffic snapshot (traffic_snapshot.csv) that shows hourly search volume for the last 7 days.

Thanks,
Elliot Price
Head of Search — StoreWise
elliot@storewise.com

Attachment: traffic_snapshot.csv (CSV, 45KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elliot Price <elliot@storewise.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-23T14:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo request - self signup

Hi Elliot — great to meet you and thanks for the snapshot. I work with similar retail search teams and a quick 30-minute call should help us align on throughput and the best deployment mode.

Before we lock time, two quick qualification points so I can tailor the demo: 
- Primary use case: embeddings + reranking for product search (yes/no?)
- Expected tokens per request (prompt + metadata + response): rough estimate (e.g., 40–100 tokens)?
- SLA or retention requirements (you attached a doc called requirement_sla.pdf?)
- Timeline: pilot in next 4 weeks, 2–3 months, or later?

Can you confirm those and pick a slot? Here are three windows that work for me (all PDT):
- Thu 2028-07-24 09:30–10:00
- Thu 2028-07-24 13:00–13:30
- Fri 2028-07-25 11:00–11:30

If none work, propose two that do and I’ll send a calendar invite. Monica (cc'd) will join to cover the Dedicated vs Hosted pricing profile.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachment: requirement_sla.pdf (referenced)

From: Elliot Price <elliot@storewise.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-23T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo request - self signup

Thanks Ben — answers below: 
- Use case: yes — embeddings + rerank, occasionally fallback to simple fuzzy match for cold-start SKUs.
- Tokens per request: median ~60 tokens (we send normalized query + 6 candidate titles + metadata), worst-case ~220 tokens with long descriptions.
- SLA/retention: we need 99.9% availability for the production path and logs retained 90 days for audits. I attached our internal SLA doc (requirement_sla.pdf).
- Timeline: hoping to pilot in ~3–6 weeks and scale after validation.

The 13:00 slot on Thu 7/24 works for me. If anything changes I'll let you know.

Cheers,
Elliot
